experience.title: MyKRI
experience.subtitle: Operational risk platform
points: Built a distributed microservices platform for near-real-time monitoring of enterprise operational risk indicators.

Operated services on Kubernetes; strengthened reliability with OAuth2, ELK/APM, HikariCP connection pooling and S3 integration.

experience.title: MyCyberRisk
experience.subtitle: Cybersecurity remediation platform
points: Built a centralized platform to ingest, classify and remediate cybersecurity anomalies with end-to-end lifecycle visibility.
Designed a metadata-driven workflow engine using a finite state machine, enabling new processes without code changes.
Engineered ingestion and enrichment pipelines, dynamic SpEL rules, RabbitMQ messaging and REST integrations.
Established Docker / Jenkins delivery on Kubernetes and automated testing with JUnit, FitNesse and Cypress; enforced SonarQube quality gates.
